vos: vos — you (object pronoun, polite/plural) · also subject 'you' (vos, que por mí dexades 'you who leave for my sake'); dative 'to you' (dar vos quiero vuestra part) · also reflexive/ethic 'you (yourselves)' (id vos en algara 'go off on a raid'); dative with an impersonal sense (si cueta vos fore 'if need befall you')
pido: pedir — I ask (present 1st sg.; que non vos pido más 'for I ask no more of you'; = pido)
merçed: merçed — mercy, favor; Merçed! 'have mercy, I beg you' (= merced) · also merçed — grace, favour (con la merçed del Criador 'by the grace of the Creator') · also en vuestra merçed 'at your disposal, at your command' (en vuestra merçed somos nos; Pidal 'estamos a vuestro mandar')
a: a — to, at · also aver — he/she has (3rd sg. present, h-less spelling of ha, as in el rey me a ayrado = el rey me ha airado) · personal a before a direct object (salvest a Jonás; a ti adoro); a + inf. 'to, about to' (tornólas a catar); a tan grand sabor 'with so great pleasure'; a ojo 'in plain sight' · also a — 'into' (sacar a çelada 'to lure into ambush'); 'at, in' (a la çaga 'at the rear'); 'against' (dar salto a la çaga); dative 'to' (a mí dedes); haber a + inf. 'have to' (lo han a far); a + noun of direction (adeliñava a la puerta 'made for the gate') · impersonal 'there is' (aver; es dia a de plazo 'there is (only) a day of the term', the most likely reading of a hard line); ha as auxiliary set after the participle (soñado a 'he has dreamt') · also 'on, at (a time)' (a tercer dia 'on the third day') · also a — 'has' before the participle, agreeing with the object (la lança a quebrada 'he has broken the lance'; a menester 'has need of'); a + dative of the person affected (a Minaya matáronle el cavallo 'they killed Minaya's horse') · a — 'as, for' (tóvoslo a grand fonta 'he took it as a great affront') · also a — 'with' of instrument (a dientes las tomó 'with his teeth he took them'; = con)
natural: natural — natural, rightful, by birth (adjective; señor natural 'a rightful lord, one owed allegiance by birth'; = natural) · also natural — native of a place, true (el Burgalés natural 'the native of Burgos'; amigo natural 'a friend by nature, true-born friend')
pues: pues — since, then; pues que 'since' · also pues + future subjunctive 'when, once' (pues fueren en vuestro poder 'when they are in your power')
que: que — that, who, which; for · also por que — because, since (= porque) · por que — by which, whereby (por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more') · also que — 'so that, lest' introducing purpose/result (que por miedo non dexen nada; por tal lo faze … que no lo ventasse nadi); after después/mientra 'after, while' (después que, mientra que) · also que — than, after a comparative (mas le vienen … que nos le van 'more come to him than leave him') · also que — what (indirect interrogative; dezir vos he que faze 'I shall tell you what he does'; = qué)
casades: casar — you marry off (present 2nd pl.; vos casades mis fijas 'you marry my daughters'; = casáis)
así: así — thus, so; así como 'as soon as'
commo: commo — as, like (spelling variant of como) · how, that, in the way that (commo sirva a doña Ximena 'how he is to serve doña Ximena'); like (commo la uña de la carne) · also commo si + imperfect subjunctive — 'as if' (commo si escapasse 'as if he were fleeing') · commo que 'as one who' (commo que ira a de rey … es echado 'as one who has the king's anger and is cast out') · also commo — 'as soon as, when' (commo gelo a dicho 'as soon as he told it him'); 'since, as' (commo fío por Dios 'as I trust in God')
plaz: plazer — it pleases (present 3rd sg., apocopated; a todos plaz 'it pleases all'; = place, closest agrada)
qui: qui — he who, whoever (old relative pronoun, Latin qui; = quien) · also qui — who? (interrogative; ¿qui los podrié contar? 'who could count them?'; = quién) · also qui after a negative — 'anyone who, one to' (non ha qui tomallos 'there is nobody to take them'; = quien)
las: el/la — the (fem. pl.); them (fem. object pronoun)
gelas: ge + las — them for/to him (ge, ancestor of modern se, + las; = se las) · also ge 'to them' (non gelas do yo 'I do not give them to them')
mi: mi — my (unstressed possessive) · also mi — me (stressed pronoun after a preposition; por mi 'on my behalf'; = mí)
mano: mano — hand (sg.); en vuestra mano = 'in your keeping' · a mano 'by hand, hand-picked' (escollechos a mano 'chosen by hand') · dar de mano 'to let go, release' (Pidal 'soltar'; darvos e de mano 'I will let you go')
dend: dend — of it, from it (variant of dent, de + ent; = de ello); in dend e the e is he 'I have' (el sabor que dend e 'the pleasure I have of it')
se: se — himself/herself/itself (reflexive pronoun) · also se — passive 'is, are' (cómmo se gana el pan 'how bread is earned'; = se, passive-reflexive) · also se — ethic/intensive dative 'for himself, with his own eyes' (él se lo vío con los ojos 'he saw it himself')
el: el — the (masc.) · also el — 'he who' before a relative (el qui quisiere, el que es sobre Fenares); el before a fem. noun beginning with a vowel (el espada = la espada; el algara = la algara) · also el de + place name 'he of, the one from' (mio Çid el de Bivar)
afé: afé — behold, here is (presentative particle, used before a noun; afé Dios del çielo 'behold God of heaven'; = he aquí; origin uncertain)
aquí: aquí — here; d'aquí 'from here' · also 'then, at this point' (aquí dixo el comde 'then the count said')
álbar: Álbar — Álvar (personal name, Álbar Fáñez; = Álvar)
manos: mano — hand (pl.); dar las manos = the handclasp that makes an agreement binding · a las manos 'for the hands' (pidió agua a las manos 'asked for water to wash his hands'); bolver las manos 'to ply the hands', busy eating · also a las manos tomar 'to take by the hand' (a las manos les tomó, Pidal 'los tomó de la mano')
e: e — and (= modern y) · also aver — I have (1st sg. present, apocopated form of he, perfect auxiliary: Espeso e el oro, 'I have spent the gold') · also aver — 'I will', the future auxiliary in a split future (quitarvos e … darvos e de mano 'I will free you … I will let you go'; = vos quitaré, vos daré) · also the full verb 'I have' (el sabor que dend e 'the delight I have of it')
los: el — the (masc. pl.); them (object pronoun) · also los que 'those who' (demonstrative use before a relative); los — him, them as object of consejar (commo los consejava 'as he advised them') · also los de 'those of' (con los de Castejón 'with the men of Castejón')
ifantes: infante — young nobleman, son of a noble house (pl., spelt Ifantes; = infantes)
prendo: prender — I take, accept (present 1st sg.; prendo esta presentaja 'I accept this gift'; = tomo; modern prender is 'to seize, arrest')
si: si — if; si + subjunctive alone = 'if only …!' · si non — otherwise, if not (si non, do sopiéredes 'if not, wherever you learn'); si + future subjunctive 'if' (si nos falláredes 'if you find us') · also si — si'nulla = sin + nulla with -n assimilated before n- (si'nulla dubda 'without any fear' (or 'doubt'); = sin ningún miedo, sin ninguna duda) · also si non — 'except, but for' (si non a estos cavalleros 'except these knights'; = salvo) · also si — 'so', optative, = sí, with the present subjunctive in an adjuration (si vos vala el Criador 'so may the Creator help you')
fosse: seer — he were (imperfect subjunctive of seer; MS fuesse, Pidal's older form) · also ir — he should go (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., the preterite stem of seer shared with ir; que f[o]sse con Minaya 'that he should go with Minaya'; = fuese)
delant: delant — ahead, in front (apocopated adverb; = delante)
dellas: de + ellas — of them, about them (contraction, fem. pl.)
tod: todo — all, the whole (apocopated before a vowel)
comigo: comigo — with me (con + migo, Latin mecum; = conmigo)
quem: que + me — that to me (= que me, worn down to a single consonant, cf. nol)
digades: dezir — (that) you say, tell (2nd pl. present subjunctive used as command, polite; digades al conde 'tell the count'; = digáis)
la: el/la — the (fem.); her/it (object pronoun) · also la que 'the one that' (Çelfa la que dizen de Canal 'Çelfa, the one they call of the Canal')
dixo: dezir — he/she said (strong preterite; x = sh-sound; = dijo)
me: me — me, to me · also reflexive 'myself' (fata que yo me pague 'until I am satisfied')
es: seer — it is (present 3rd sg.) · also ser as perfect auxiliary of intransitives (exido es 'has gone out') and passive auxiliary (la tienda es cogida) · also es — that (apocopated esse = ese, demonstrative; en es alcaz 'in that pursuit', por es logar 'through that place')
puesto: poner — set (past part.; non era puesto el sol 'the sun had not set'; = puesto)
sabed: saber — know, take note of (imperative 2nd pl.; e vos sabed el mensage 'and you, learn the message'; = sabed)
en: en — in, into, on · en — of it, thence (= ende; por en avemos qué fablar 'of which we have to speak') · also en — 'as' (en paria 'as tribute'); en essora 'at that moment' · also en — 'among' (en todos los sos 'among all his men') · also en + infinitive 'in (doing)' (en levarlo adelant 'in carrying it forward'); en çinco días 'in five days'
recabdo: recabdo — care, precaution, strict order (= recaudo) · also recabdo — business secured, a sure outcome (con todo buen recabdo 'with everything well in hand') · recabdo — account, reckoning (oro e plata que non saben recabdo 'gold and silver past all reckoning') · also con recabdo — within bounds, under control (non es con recabdo el dolor de Valençia 'the grief of Valencia is past all bounds') · also todo el recabdo está 'every precaution is taken' (Pidal: 'hay toda clase de precauciones'; en Medina todo el recabdo está)
ya: ya — O! (vocative particle, Arabic yā); also 'now, already' · also ya — 'would', reduced imperfect of aver as conditional ending, 3rd sg., after infinitive + clitic (pagar se ya 'would be satisfied'; = -ía)
don: don — don, lord (honorific title) · also don — gift (noun; en don 'as a gift') · also don — from where, whence (= donde, de onde; Castejón don abremos grand enpara 'Castejón, from which we shall have great protection') · 'whereof, with which' (Pidal 'de lo cual'; don yo sea pagado 'whereof I may be satisfied') · also don — when, where (= donde, of time; Don llegan los otros 'when the others come up')
ondrado: ondrar — honored, esteemed (past part. as adjective, masc. sg.; rey ondrado 'honored king'; = honrado)
destas: de + estas — of these (preposition de + demonstrative estas fem. pl.; destas mis ganançias 'of these my gains'; = de estas)
vistas: vistas — meeting, interview of persons (fem. pl. noun; a vistas 'to a meeting'; = vistas, entrevista)
de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por) · also de — 'by (night)' (de noch), partitive 'of, among' (quinze moros … de los que alcançava; pocas de gentes), 'as' (de ganançia 'as booty'), 'from outside' (de fuera), 'on the right' (de diestro) · also 'about, concerning' (de mí non digan mal 'let them not speak ill of me') · also de — 'as if in' (commo de arrancada 'as if in rout'); 'in the manner of' (de guisa 'in such a way'); 'of, among' (de bivos pocos 'of the living few'); nominalized infinitive (del prender 'of the taking') · also de — 'with' of manner (de fuertes coraçones 'with stout hearts'); 'on' (de pie 'on foot'); 'from' of side (della e della part 'from both sides'); de cabo 'anew' (de + cabo, 'again'); de suso de 'above'; seños … de seños colpes 'with one blow each' · also de — 'in respect of' after an adjective (sobejana de mala 'exceedingly bad'); 'with regard to, about' (me plaze de mio Çid 'I am pleased about the Cid'); 'from, at the hand of' (de señor non ha graçia 'he gets no favor from a lord'); 'from' of origin (de moros fo 'it came from Moors'); 'at' of manner (de vagar 'at leisure', de + the noun vagar) · also de’ — Pidal's de’llaño, read as del llaño 'of the plain' (the article's l run into the ll; a reading, not certain) · de + infinitive after an adjective (de ir somos guisados 'we are ready to go') · also de + infinitive after a verb: començar de 'to begin to' (compeçó de fablar 'he began to speak'), piénssanse de 'set about' (piénssanse de armar), aver de 'to have to' (lo que ha de far 'what he has to do') · also de — 'within' of a time limit (De aquestos quinze días, most likely 'within these fifteen days'; sense uncertain); de veluntad 'willingly'; de + superlative partitive (de los mejores guarnimientos 'of the best equipment')
algo: algo — something; the poem's discreet word for money, wealth
palafrés: palafré — palfrey, riding horse (pl.; a gentle horse for ordinary riding rather than war; = palafrenes)
bien: bien — well · bien — good, benefit (noun; algún bien vos pueda far 'some good I may do you') · bien — very, quite, intensifying an adverb (bien çerca del agua 'very near the water')
adobados: adobar — equipped, ready (past part. masc. pl.; todos son adobados 'all are ready'; = pertrechados, aderezados)
corredores: corredor — raider, outrider sent out to scour the country (masc. pl.; davan sus corredores 'he sent out his raiders'; = corredores, closest 'exploradores, incursores') · also corredor — swift, fast-running (adjective, of horses; cavallos gruessos e corredores 'stout, swift horses'; = veloces)
tomad: tomar — take! (imperative 2nd pl.; la mi seña tomad 'take my banner'; = tomad)
mucho: mucho — much, greatly · also mucho — very, intensifying a predicate (mucho es mañana 'it is much too early, too soon') · also mas mucho — 'more' (mucho as a comparative = más: mas mucho fue provechosa 'was more profitable'; Pidal)
avedes: aver — you have (2nd pl. present, -edes; perfect auxiliary with a participle, me avedes mandado 'you have granted me'; = habéis)
reçibo: reçebir — I receive, accept (present 1st sg.; = recibo)
mandado: mandado — message, news, word (noun; from mandar 'to send, order') · also mandado — order, command (mandado de so señor 'the lord's command'); fazer mandado 'to send word' · also past part. 'granted, assigned' (el quinto que me avedes mandado 'the fifth you have granted me')
plega: plazer — may it please (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; plega a Dios 'may it please God'; = plazca)
al: a + el — to the; al menos 'even the least' · also a + el standing for a + la before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel (al espada = a la espada) · also al — 'other thing, the rest' (neuter, Latin alius; de lo al non pienssan nada 'of anything else they think nothing'; distinct from a + el) · also a + el before an infinitive 'on, upon' (al exir de Salón 'on leaving the Jalón'; = al salir) · al 'the other thing, the rest' in al feredes adelant 'the rest you will do later' · also por al 'otherwise, for any other reason' (non passará por al 'it will not be otherwise'); a mí mandedes al 'order me something else', give me another charge (the likelier reading of a terse line)
sos: so — his, her, their (= modern sus) · also los sos 'his own men' (possessive with article as noun; en todos los sos 'among all his men')
santos: santo — saint (masc. pl.); los sos santos 'his saints' · also adjective, holy (los santos padres 'the holy fathers')
feches: fazer — you do (present 2nd pl., a reduced form of fazedes; esto feches agora 'this you do now'; the sense is clear, the exact derivation less so; = hacéis)
sea: seer — may be, that is (present subjunctive 3rd sg.) · also 'let it be' as a hortatory subjunctive (aquí sea la batalla 'let the battle be here')
mio: mio — my (unstressed possessive; mio Çid 'my lord Cid')
çid: Çid — the Cid, 'lord' (Arabic sīdī 'my lord'; pronounced Tsid)
roy: Roy — Ruy, short for Rodrigo (Roy Díaz = Rodrigo Díaz, the Cid)
diaz: Díaz — Díaz (patronymic 'son of Diego'; Ruy Diaz, the Cid's name, = Ruy Díaz; same as díaz, here without accent)
so: so/su — his, her, its (unstressed possessive sg.; so çervicio = su servicio); also seer — I am (1st sg. present; = soy; so ayrado, 'I am in [the king's] ira') · lo so — 'what is his, his own' (neuter article + possessive; lo so puede menguar 'what is his may dwindle') · also so — their (so consejo 'their counsel', so vino 'their wine'; = su)
por: por — through, along, by, for · purpose, 'in order to' (por el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'); por + inf. 'yet to be done' (tres an por troçir 'three remain to pass'); 'for, on behalf of' (por mio Çid) · also por — 'out of, because of' (por miedo 'through fear'); 'for (that reason)' (por tal lo faze 'he does it for that reason'); 'by way of' (por Guadalfajara); por + noun 'for the sake of' ; por coraçón 'willingly' · also 'for (a price)' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'by means of' (por carta 'by writ'); 'through, thanks to' (por mí ganaredes 'through me you will gain') · also por — 'on, during (a time)' (por aquesta mañana 'this morning'); 'by way of, through' (por medio de la llaña 'through the middle of the plain') · also por — 'in' after fiar (yo fío por Dios 'I trust in God') · also por — 'to fetch, for' after enbiar/ir (enbiaré por ellas, irán por ellas 'I shall send for them', 'they will go for them'); por cuenta 'by count, in a count' · also por — as (por heredad 'as a possession') · also por — 'about, after' with preguntar (por el rey tómanse a preguntar 'they begin to ask after the king'); por + infinitive 'for … to' (por … vençer reyes, 'for … to defeat kings')
pagado: pagar — satisfied, pleased; also paid (past part.; será pagado = 'he will be content with')
aun: aun — even, besides · also aun — yet, still (aun vea el dia 'may I yet see the day') · also 'even though' (= aunque; aun de lo que diessen oviessen grand ganançia, Pidal's reading)
ayades: aver — you may have (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; = hayáis)
dios: Dios — God · also Dios! — interjection of wonder (Dios, cómmo se alabavan! 'God, how they boasted!')
acomiendo: acomendar — I entrust, commend (present 1st sg.; = encomiendo)
del: de + el — of the (contraction) · also del standing for de + la before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel (del albergada = de la albergada) · also del — 'from, for, because of' (cause; del gozo 'from the joy'; del çerviçio 'for the service')
lo: lo — him, it (object pronoun) · lo que perdedes 'that which you lose' (neuter antecedent of the relative) · also lo — neuter article 'what is' (lo to 'what is yours'); pleonastic 'it' (lo an, lo han a far; por tal lo faze 'for that reason he does it')
bavieca: Bavieca — Babieca, the Cid's horse (proper name; = Babieca)
salto: salto — leap, jump · also dash, sally (dar salto 'to make a sortie'; non osa ninguno dar salto a la çaga 'none dares to dash at the rearguard')
dio: dar — he gave, struck (preterite 3rd sg.; un colpe dio 'he struck a blow'; = dio) · dar a + inf. 'to give (something) to be …-ed' (Dio a partir estos dineros 'he had this money shared out') · also dar — he dispatched, sent (Pidal: 'despachó, envió'; Dio tres cavalleros 'he dispatched three knights'; = envió)
digo: dezir — I say (present 1st sg.; yo non vos digo nada 'I say nothing to you'; = digo)
ante: ante — before; ante que 'before (that)' · also ante — because of, at (of the cause, like Latin prae; ante roído de atamores 'at the din of the drums')
quiere: querer — he wants (present 3rd sg.; non lo quiere comer 'he will not eat it'; = quiere) · also 'is about to' (el março quiere entrar 'March is about to come in')
ir: ir — to go (infinitive; = ir) · ir + gerund in a split future (ir nos hemos pagando 'we shall go on paying ourselves'; = nos iremos pagando) · also ir + infinitive in a split future (ir los hemos fferir 'we shall go and strike them'; = los iremos a herir)
bodas: boda — wedding, wedding feast (fem. pl.; en sus bodas 'in their wedding'; = bodas)
o: o — or; also ó — where (interrogative, Latin ubi; ¿O sodes…? 'Where are you…?') · also o — where (relative adverb; o dizen Castejón 'which they call Castejón'; o el Campeador estava 'where the Campeador was'; = donde) · correlative 'either … or' (o me dexaredes … o … levaredes 'either you will leave me … or you will take away')
vaya: ir — let him go (present subjunctive 3rd sg., jussive; = vaya)
cuedo: cuedar — I think, suppose (present 1st sg.; old form of cuidar in its old sense 'to think'; commo yo cuedo 'as I think'; = creo, pienso)
quel: que + le — who ... him (que + enclitic/elided le) · that ... to him (quel creçe conpaña 'that company grows for him')
avrá: aver — he will have (future 3rd sg., syncopated; aver a + inf. 'will have to': me avrá a dar 'he will have to give me'; = habrá) · also aver — there will be (impersonal, with i 'there'; dubda non i avrá 'there will be no doubt'; = habrá)
pro: pro — worth, merit; de pro 'worthy, of good standing' · also pro — profit, advantage, benefit (grant pro les fazié 'he did them great good, was of great profit to them')
yas: ya + se — already … themselves (ya + reflexive se cut to s; yas mueven 'they are already moving'; = ya se)
espidió: espedirse — he took leave (preterite 3rd sg., with the reflexive se placed before: se espidió; = se despidió)
luégol: luego + l(e) — at once it (luego + le; le probably takes up el campo as object, an odd use, so not certain; luégol atravessavan 'at once they crossed it'; = luego lo atravesaban; the accent shows the stress stays on lué-)
quitó: quitar — he left, quit, gave up (preterite 3rd sg.; quitó a Alcoçer 'he left Alcocer'; = dejó, abandonó)
veriedes: veer — you would have seen (conditional 2nd pl.; = veríais; the minstrel's aside to the audience)
son: seer — they are (3rd pl.) · also son — perfect auxiliary of intransitives and passive auxiliary (todos son exidos 'have all gone out'; nombrados son; son derramadas 'are scattered')
poder: poder — to be able (infinitive; first half of a split future, poder nos han alcançar 'they will be able to overtake us'; = poder) · also poder — power, hands, control (noun; en so poder 'in his keeping'; = poder)
valençia: Valençia — Valencia, the Moorish kingdom and city whose king Tamín is addressed (= Valencia)
mayor: mayor — larger, greater (aquella mayor az 'that greatest line'; = mayor) · also Mayor — part of the place name Mont Mayor, Montemayor (the Portuguese town, Pidal)
seremos: seer — we shall be (future 1st pl.; = seremos)
d: de — of, with (elided form of de before a vowel, d'arena = de arena) · de — from (unos d'otros 'one from another') · also d — 'about, concerning' (D' iffantes de Carrión yo vos quiero contar 'of the Infantes of Carrión I wish to tell you'; = de)
carrión: Carrión — Carrión de los Condes, town in Palencia, seat of the counts of Carrión (= Carrión)
he: aver — I have (1st sg. present; perfect auxiliary, = he, and the auxiliary of the split future, e.g. doblar vos he)
elvira: Elvira — Elvira, one of the Cid's two daughters (doña Elvira, also printed don Elvira; = Elvira)
doña: doña — lady (title; Latin domina, fem. of don)
sol: sol — sun · also 'even, so much as' (sol non 'not even'; sol non será penssado 'it will not even be thought of') · also sol — so + l, 'under the' (so 'under', Latin sub, + el before a vowel): del sol espada 'from under the sword' (the likeliest reading; the construction is uncertain)
plogo: plazer — it pleased (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = plugo, modern plació)
creçe: crecer — grows, increases (present 3rd sg.; = crece, ç sounded ts)
yentes: yente — people, folk (= gente; y- from Latin g-)
van: ir — they go (present 3rd pl.) · also ir + gerund 'keep going' (passando van 'they go on passing') · also ir + infinitive 'go to' (le van çercar 'they go to besiege him'; se van tornar 'they go back')
canpeador: Campeador — spelling variant with n for m (copyist's spelling) of Campeador, the Cid's epithet
adeliñan: adeliñar — they head for, make straight for (present 3rd pl.; adeliñan tras mio Çid 'they make straight after my Çid'; = se encaminan, se dirigen)
punto: punto — moment, point of time, hour (en tan buen punto 'at so good a moment'; = punto, closest hora/ocasión)
aguardar: aguardar — to watch, keep watch on (infinitive; mandó aguardar 'ordered (him) watched'; = aguardar) · also aguardar — to guard, serve and attend (Pidal: 'igual que guardar, servir y atender'; que los ha de aguardar 'who is to look after them on the road'; = guardar, atender)
mandó: mandar — he ordered (preterite 3rd sg.; = mandó) · also mandar — 'he held, governed' a place (Çorita mandó 'he held Çorita'; el que mandó a Mont Mayor 'he who governed Mont Mayor')
per: Per — Pero, short for Pedro (Per Vermudoz = Pedro Bermúdez, a vassal of the Cid)
muño: Muño — personal name (Muño Gustioz, a vassal of the Cid; = Munio, an old name; Nuño is probably related)
gustioz: Gustioz — patronymic 'son of Gustio' (Muño Gustioz, the Cid's retainer, brought up in his household; = Gustioz, no modern form)
casa: casa — house; also settlement, town (Burgos la casa 'the town of Burgos')
dos: dos — two · also do + se, 'when/where … (they)' (Dos fallan con los moros 'when they come upon the Moors', Pidal 'cuando se encuentran'; = cuando se encuentran)
mejores: mejor — better, best (pl.; de los mejores guarnimientos 'of the best equipment'; = mejores)
sopiessen: saber — (so that) they might know (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl.; = supiesen/supieran)
va: ir — he/she goes (present 3rd sg.; = va); ir + gerund, 'to be (gradually) doing' · ir + infinitive 'goes to' (la manol va besar 'goes to kiss his hand', el Duero va passar 'goes to cross the Duero') · also va — 'there is, goes on' impersonal (¡Qué priessa va en los moros! 'what a stir there is among the Moors!')
i: e/i — and (variant of e before some sounds) · also i — there, therein (adverb, Latin ibi, like French y; meted i las fedes, 'put your pledged faith into it')
era: seer — it was (imperfect of seer = ser) · era + past part. 'had' (ser as pluperfect auxiliary with intransitives; Minaya assí era llegado 'Minaya had arrived')
mas: mas — but · also mas — 'most' (superlative, = más; en todo lo mas alto 'on the very highest part') · also mas — 'more' comparative (que es mas ondrada 'which is more honored'; = más)
les: les — to them · also les — 'from them', dative of removal or injury (les tollió el pan 'took the bread from them'; viédales exir 'forbids them to go out')
dan: dar — they give (present 3rd pl.; vagar non se dan 'they allow themselves no leisure'; = dan) · also dar — 'to pay (tribute)' (dan parias 'they pay tribute')
gañó: gañar — he won, captured (preterite 3rd sg.; = ganó)
ella: ella — she, her (stressed 3rd sg. fem. pronoun)
gozos: gozo — joy, rejoicing (masc. pl.; grandes son los gozos 'great is the rejoicing'; = gozos)
pero: Pero — Peter (San Pero = San Pedro, the saint of the monastery)
un: uno — a, one (apocopated masc. before a noun)
ellos: ellos — they, them (stressed 3rd pl. masc. pronoun)
mando: mandar — I promise, vow; I order (present 1st sg.) · also mandar — he ordered (preterite 3rd sg., unaccented spelling of mandó; el Campeador a los sos lo mando 'the Campeador ordered his men'; = mandó)
viniere: venir — (if) it come (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; si vos viniere emiente 'if it come to your mind'; = viniere)
mañana: mañana — morning (a la mañana 'in the morning'; otro dia mañana 'next morning'; = mañana) · also mañana — early, soon (adverb/predicate; mucho es mañana 'it is too soon (to take back a man in disgrace after only three weeks)'; = pronto, temprano)
verán: veer — they will see (future 3rd pl.; verán las moradas 'they will see the dwellings'; = verán)
noch: noche — night (apocopated form of noche; cf. anoch)
foron: seer — they were (preterite 3rd pl., variant of fueron; = fueron) · also foron — they went (ir, which shares this preterite; F[o]ron los mandados a todas partes 'the messages went everywhere')
campeador: Campeador — the Battler, the Champion (the Cid's epithet, from campo 'field of battle')
alcáçer: alcáçer — citadel, fortress (Arabic al-qaṣr; en somo del alcáçer 'on top of the citadel'; = alcázar)
reçibiólo: reçibir + lo — he received him (preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic lo; = lo recibió)
amas: amos — both (fem. pl., Latin ambas; las manos amas 'both hands'; = ambas)
venides: venir — you come (2nd pl. present, old -des ending; = venís)
buena: bueno — good (fem.); en buen(a) '(born/girded) in a good hour' — the poem's honorific formula
çinxiestes: çeñir — you girded (strong preterite 2nd pl. of çeñir; Latin cinxistis)
dias: día — day (pl.; diez dias 'ten days'; = días)
grado: grado — thanks (grado a … 'thanks be to …') · also grado — will, good will (de grado 'willingly, gladly'; de grado non avrié nada, 'of good will there would be nothing to be had') · en grado tener 'to be thankful for' (en grado vos lo tengo 'I thank you for it')
ondrada: ondrar — honored, splendid (past part. fem. used as adj.; = honrada)
avremos: aver — we shall have (future 1st pl., syncopated; a ir nos avremos 'we shall have to go', aver a + inf. with the clitic nos set inside the phrase; = habremos)
ondrança: ondrança — honor, ceremony (a grant ondrança 'with great honor'; = honra, closest honra/pompa)
ca: ca — for, because (Latin quia) · ca — perhaps 'but, whereas' (el uno es en paradiso, ca el otro non entró allá; the sense is uncertain) · also ca non — 'and not that' (Pidal 'y no que'; cuédanse que es almofalla, ca non vienen con mandado 'they think it is an army, and not that they come with a message')
casadas: casar — married, settled in marriage (past part. fem. pl.; tener por casadas 'to count themselves married'; = casadas)
